Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/18/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 65 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Polygraph Examiners Board until October 1, 2023 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 65 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Polygraph Examiners Board until October 1, 2023 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
